fishing: WHEN: Tue Oct 20 NE winds 15-20kt, moderate chop, better early/late. PASSES-BEACH: snook slowing, redfish & flounder near passes on live shrimp/gold spoons. LEMON BAY: mangrove snapper around docks/pier, redfish & small snook near mangroves/docks, trout on flats (Fishin Franks 10/9). NEARSHORE: limited by weather, mangrove snapper & occasional cobia. Baits: live shrimp, gold spoons, soft plastics, pinfish, cutbait.
redtide: FWC Oct 16: K. brevis at background concentrations in 6 samples from/offshore SWFL (Sarasota in/offshore, Hillsborough offshore). Not present in Charlotte/Lee/Collier. No fish kills or respiratory irritation past week.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD ~10 CFU/100mL (DOH Charlotte Healthy Beaches, sample ~Oct 5). No advisory.
fpl: Charlotte/Sarasota small isolated outages only, no major Englewood impact.
